candidates.name: Agora

evidence.short_quote: Zwolnienia mają ostatecznie objąć maksymalnie 166 osób

methodology.reviewer: AI research agent; no human verification claimed
methodology.search_scope: Each of the 26 candidates searched individually, prioritizing company announcements, investor documents and regulatory filings. Selected pages opened and read.
methodology.count_policy: No combined job-loss total: units, conditionality, attrition, redeployment, outsourcing and completion status differ.
methodology.dedup_policy: Normalized names, seed slugs and aliases compared; all seed website_url fields are null, so domain matching against seed cannot be completed.
methodology.publication_gate: No candidate is approved for publication or ingestion. Unknowns and counterevidence require editorial review.
